title: A NJ teenager drops her lawsuit against Meta, Google, and Snap over alleged social media addiction, without any payment; TikTok previously settled her claims (Diana Novak Jones/Reuters)
summary: Diana Novak Jones / Reuters: A NJ teenager drops her lawsuit against Meta, Google, and Snap over alleged social media addiction, without any payment; TikTok previously settled her claims — A teen girl whose lawsuit was a test case in litigation accusing social media companies of deliberately addicting young people …
